portfolio.name: Hashan Perera
portfolio.summary: Software engineer with 3+ years of experience building, supporting, and deploying production applications across .NET, Angular, React, NestJS, MongoDB, SQL Server, and AWS.
about: I build software that connects thoughtful interfaces with dependable systems. Based in Horana, Sri Lanka, my work spans enterprise .NET applications, Angular and NestJS platforms, and mobile tools that work even when connectivity doesn’t.

Currently at IGT1 Lanka – Sitecore, I investigate production incidents, debug .NET applications, and deliver carefully validated fixes for global customers. Previously at DigitusTec, I led a three-engineer team and built full-stack business applications with SAP Business One integrations.

I care about clean architecture, secure APIs, and the details that make software reliable. I use AI-assisted tools for coding, debugging, refactoring, and testing, grounded in code review and engineering fundamentals.

experience.summary: I resolve production issues and deliver validated fixes for enterprise Sitecore XP and .NET applications used by global customers.
highlights: Investigate incidents across application code, .NET assemblies, SQL Server data, configuration, and runtime behavior.
Implement and validate code-level fixes with a focus on regression risk and production stability.
Work within structured engineering, troubleshooting, and customer communication practices.

points: Investigate and resolve production incidents for enterprise Sitecore XP and .NET applications used by global customers, performing root-cause analysis across application code, .NET assemblies, SQL Server data, configuration, and runtime behavior.
Debug .NET-based applications and implement code level fixes for identified defects, validating changes carefully to minimize regression risk and maintain production stability.
Work within a large enterprise software environment, developing and validating solutions while following structured engineering, troubleshooting, and customer communication practices.

projects.name: Meeting Minutes
projects.problem: Organizations needed a centralized platform to manage meeting minutes, tasks, approvals, and follow-ups while maintaining secure access and good performance with growing data.
projects.whatIDid:
Led development with a 3-engineer team and designed the Angular project architecture. Built meeting, task, and approval modules, integrated REST APIs, and optimized large data tables.

Developed the NestJS backend, implemented Auth0 JWT authentication with RBAC, and improved MongoDB performance using indexing and aggregation pipelines. Also handled code reviews, CI/CD, and Docker-based deployment standards.
projects.architectureLead: Built as a modular monolithic application.
projects.architectureDescription:
The NestJS backend is separated into modules for meetings, tasks, approvals, users, and authentication while being deployed as a single application.

Auth0 handles authentication, with JWT validation and role-based authorization on the backend.
projects.roleDescription: Responsible for frontend and backend architecture, core development, database optimization, security, code reviews, CI/CD, and technical guidance for the development team.
projects.description: From meeting discussions to clear actions, tasks, and approvals. Led end-to-end delivery with a three-engineer team.
projects.label: Meet. Decide. Follow through.
projects.detail: Led the end-to-end development of the Meeting Minutes platform, defining the Angular architecture, project structure, and CI/CD workflows for a three-engineer team.
highlights: Built responsive meetings, tasks, and approvals modules, with optimized rendering, filtering, and pagination for large data tables.
Architected the NestJS backend with role-based access control and Auth0 JWT authentication.
Established Docker deployment standards and improved MongoDB queries using aggregation pipelines and indexing.

projects.name: Outgrower
projects.problem:
Field officers needed a reliable way to manage external farmers in rural areas with unstable or limited internet connectivity.

The application had to support 500+ field users while keeping data available offline and synchronizing safely once connectivity returned.
projects.whatIDid:
Solely developed the mobile application using Flutter and GetX, with Hive DB for local offline storage.

Implemented an offline-first synchronization mechanism with queued operations, retry handling, and automatic data synchronization.

Developed the NestJS backend, integrated SAP Business One through the Service Layer, and built a responsive UI optimized for field usage.
projects.architectureLead: Designed as an offline-first mobile application.
projects.architectureDescription:
Hive stores data locally when users are offline. Pending operations are added to a synchronization queue and sent to the backend once connectivity is restored.

NestJS handles business logic, MongoDB data operations, and communication with SAP Business One through the SAP B1 Service Layer.
projects.roleDescription: Responsible for mobile development, backend APIs, offline synchronization, SAP B1 integration, database handling, and the overall technical implementation of the application.
projects.description: A field-ready agricultural app with offline storage and reliable synchronization, enabling access for 500+ users.
projects.label: Built for the field.
projects.detail: Solely developed the Outgrower mobile application for a Zambian agricultural company to manage external farmers in low-connectivity environments.
highlights: Created a responsive Flutter interface optimized for field usage, using GetX for state management.
Implemented Hive local storage and queued synchronization with retry handling.
Built a scalable NestJS backend and integrated it with the SAP B1 Service Layer.

projects.name: Patient Management
projects.problem: The Asthma Patient Clinic at the University of Colombo needed a digital system to manage patient records and clinical information more efficiently instead of relying on manual record-keeping processes.
projects.whatIDid:
Solely developed the complete patient management system using Next.js.

Built the frontend interfaces for patient registration, record management, and clinical data handling, while also developing the backend API endpoints directly within the Next.js application.

Integrated MongoDB for persistent patient data storage and deployed the production application on Vercel.
projects.architectureLead: Built as a full-stack Next.js application.
projects.architectureDescription: Next.js handles both the frontend and server-side API endpoints, keeping the application within a single codebase. MongoDB is used for storing and retrieving patient and clinical records.
projects.roleDescription: Responsible for the complete application, including UI development, API endpoint development, database integration, application logic, deployment, and production maintenance.
projects.description: Digital medical record management for Colombo University, with secure data handling and a live deployment.
projects.label: Records, thoughtfully connected.
projects.detail: Developed a patient management system for Colombo University to manage digital medical records.
highlights: Built digital record management features using Next.js and MongoDB.
Implemented secure data handling.
Deployed the live system on Vercel.

projects.name: POS-R
projects.problem:
Restaurants often handle orders, kitchen communication, payments, expenses, and daily reconciliation through separate tools or manual processes, creating billing errors and poor operational visibility.

POS-R centralizes the complete restaurant workflow from order creation and kitchen processing to payments, reporting, and end-of-day reconciliation.
projects.whatIDid:
Solely designed and developed the complete POS platform using Next.js.

Built cashier, kitchen, and admin workflows covering dine-in and takeaway orders, table management, kitchen status tracking, payments, expenses, reporting, user management, and end-of-day reconciliation.

Implemented JWT authentication, order history snapshots, reporting exports, receipt printing, and direct thermal printer and cash-drawer integration using QZ Tray.
projects.architectureLead: Built as a full-stack Next.js application.
projects.architectureDescription:
React Query handles server-state fetching and caching, while Zustand manages local POS state such as carts, tables, authentication, and settings.

QZ Tray connects the application directly with thermal printers and cash drawers, while order snapshots preserve historical pricing, tax, extras, and staff information for accurate reporting.
projects.roleDescription: Responsible for complete system architecture, frontend and backend development, database design, authentication, POS workflows, kitchen operations, payment handling, reporting, hardware integration, testing, and deployment.
projects.description: A unified restaurant platform for orders, kitchen operations, payments, reporting, and end-of-day reconciliation.
projects.label: From order to close, all in one flow.
projects.outcome: Complete restaurant operations in one system
projects.detail: Designed and developed a full-stack restaurant POS covering cashier, kitchen, administration, reporting, and hardware integration.
highlights: Built dine-in, takeaway, table, kitchen, payment, expense, and reporting workflows.
Implemented JWT authentication, order snapshots, and reporting exports.
Integrated thermal printers and cash drawers directly through QZ Tray.

projects.name: LilyLanka
projects.problem:
LilyLanka required a centralized travel platform where tourists could discover local tour guides and explore structured tour packages for travelling across Sri Lanka.

The platform needed maintainable backend services and responsive frontend experiences to support growing travel and booking-related features.
projects.whatIDid:
Worked as a contract Software Engineer for 3 months, contributing to both frontend and backend development.

Developed the Tours and Tour Packages features using React and .NET, including user interfaces, business logic, and REST API endpoints.

Applied CQRS and MediatR patterns on the backend to separate commands and queries and maintain a clean, scalable application structure.
projects.architectureLead: Built using a React + .NET client-server architecture following Clean Architecture principles.
projects.architectureDescription:
React handles the customer-facing tour experiences, while the .NET backend processes business operations through separated command and query handlers using MediatR.

Clean Architecture separates the API, application, domain, and infrastructure responsibilities, making features easier to maintain, test, and extend.
projects.roleDescription: Contributed as a full-stack engineer, developing the Tours and Tour Packages modules across React and .NET, including frontend interfaces, API development, business logic, and CQRS/MediatR implementation.
projects.description: A travel platform for discovering local guides and exploring structured tour packages across Sri Lanka.
projects.label: Discover Sri Lanka, one journey at a time.
projects.detail: Contributed to Tours and Tour Packages features across a React frontend and a .NET backend using CQRS and MediatR.
highlights: Developed responsive interfaces for Tours and Tour Packages.
Built .NET REST API endpoints and supporting business logic.
Applied CQRS and MediatR to separate command and query responsibilities.

projects.name: Quality Control System
projects.problem:
The organization needed a configurable quality-control system integrated with SAP B1 to validate goods and production outputs across different operational stages.

The system had to support multiple workflows such as PO, GRN, Goods Returns, Production Receipts, and IBT while allowing users to define custom QC stages and quality parameters.
projects.whatIDid:
Developed backend features using NestJS and frontend modules using Angular.

Implemented functionality related to GRN processing, QC stage configuration, and QC parameter management, allowing quality checks to be defined and applied at different stages of the operational workflow.

Also contributed to SAP B1 integration and supported the connection between application workflows and ERP data.
projects.architectureLead: Built as a full-stack enterprise application.
projects.architectureDescription:
QC stages and parameters are configured within the application and applied to relevant business workflows. NestJS handles business logic and communicates with SAP B1 for ERP-related transactions and data synchronization.

The application is hosted on AWS.
projects.roleDescription: Responsible for backend feature development, Angular UI implementation, GRN-related functionality, QC stage and parameter management, and contributing to SAP B1 integration.
projects.description: Configurable quality checks for purchasing and production workflows, connected with SAP Business One.
projects.label: Quality, configured at every stage.
projects.detail: Developed configurable quality-control workflows and contributed to SAP Business One integration.
highlights: Developed NestJS backend features and Angular frontend modules.
Implemented GRN processing, QC stage configuration, and QC parameter management.
Connected application workflows with SAP B1 ERP data.

projects.name: CYOL
projects.problem:
Large-scale agricultural and outgrower operations often manage farms, crops, farmers, labor, inventory, procurement, and financial activities across spreadsheets and disconnected systems.

CYOL provides a centralized platform for managing the complete agricultural operation, giving organizations better visibility into farm activities, crop progress, outgrower performance, inventory, financial exposure, and operational planning.
projects.whatIDid:
Contributed to the development of the full-stack platform across Angular and NestJS, working with business modules covering farm management, crop planning, outgrowers, inventory, procurement, labor, and reporting.

Implemented and supported REST APIs, MongoDB data models, dashboard interfaces, business workflows, validation, and role-based access control.

Worked with integrations including SAP Business One, AWS S3, real-time WebSocket communication, and OpenAI-powered agricultural assistance.

The platform also supports configurable crop plans, activity tracking, plan-vs-actual monitoring, farmer contracts, material issuance, harvest tracking, purchase orders, GRNs, warehouse operations, loans, and operational reporting.
projects.architectureLead: Built as a modular client-server enterprise application.
projects.architectureDescription:
The NestJS backend is organized into domain-focused modules including Farm Management, Crop Management, Crop Planning, Outgrowers, Inventory, Labour, Microfinance, and Users. REST APIs handle standard application operations, while Socket.IO WebSockets provide real-time dashboard and notification updates.

External systems are isolated through a dedicated integration layer connecting NestJS with the SAP B1 Service Layer, AWS S3, OpenAI, and email services. JWT authentication, permission-based authorization, and MFA protect application access.

The frontend provides dashboards, maps, crop-planning calendars, Gantt views, analytics, and Excel/PDF reporting.
projects.roleDescription:
Contributed across frontend and backend development, business workflow implementation, API development, MongoDB data handling, enterprise integrations, reporting, and platform feature development.

Worked within a large domain-driven agricultural platform covering operational planning, outgrower management, inventory, procurement, finance, analytics, and external system integration.
projects.description: A centralized platform for farm planning, outgrowers, inventory, procurement, finance, and real-time agricultural operations.
projects.label: Every field operation, connected.
projects.detail: Contributed across the full stack of a domain-driven agricultural management platform with enterprise integrations and real-time features.
highlights: Developed Angular and NestJS features across farm, crop, outgrower, inventory, procurement, labor, and reporting domains.
Implemented APIs, MongoDB models, dashboards, validation, and permission-based access control.
Worked with SAP Business One, AWS S3, WebSockets, OpenAI, and reporting integrations.

projects.name: InsureGeini
projects.detailSubtitle: Final Year Research Project — Grade A | NBQSA Selected
projects.problem:
Vehicle insurance claims involve manual damage assessment, fraud verification, policy checking, and customer communication, making the process slow and difficult to scale.

InsureGeini was developed as a multimodal AI platform to automate and improve the end-to-end vehicle insurance claiming process.
projects.whatIDid:
Developed the Insurance Claim Fraud Detection module, identifying suspicious claims through historical-image comparison, driver and vehicle validation, OCR-based document extraction, facial verification, and GPS accident-location checks.

I also architected the overall system, defined communication between AI services, designed the AWS deployment architecture, and implemented containerized deployment, CI/CD, messaging, storage, and monitoring.
projects.architectureLead: Built using an AI microservices architecture.
projects.architectureDescription:
Independent Python/FastAPI services handle damage assessment, fraud detection, sentiment analysis, and policy mapping. RabbitMQ manages asynchronous processing between services.

Services are containerized with Docker, stored in AWS ECR, deployed through ECS, use S3 for media storage, and are monitored through CloudWatch, with CI/CD handling deployments.
projects.roleDescription: Responsible for the fraud detection research component, overall service architecture, microservice communication, AWS deployment architecture, Docker/ECS infrastructure, RabbitMQ integration, CI/CD, and production monitoring.
projects.description: An AI-powered insurance platform connecting damage detection, fraud analysis, sentiment, and policy matching.
projects.label: From incident to insight.
projects.detail: Developed an AI-powered insurance platform that automates claim processing by combining vehicle damage detection, fraud detection, customer sentiment analysis, and incident-to-policy mapping.
highlights: Worked with AI, machine learning, NLP, OCR, YOLO, VGG16, DeepFace, and CNN technologies.
Used a microservices stack with Python, AWS ECS, Docker, CI/CD, GitHub, and RabbitMQ.
Final-year project awarded Grade A and selected for NBQSA, with peer-reviewed research on the system at ICECET 2025, Paris.
